confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sardinian and Italian pricing for July; no live booking pages or listings were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is a bounded estimate with wider uncertainty, especially for July peak-season rates. Drink anchors are set from typical Italian and Sardinian bar pricing rather than direct menu data. FX value 0.6947 was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange-rates page and a secondary mirror; the F11.1 table was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Italian coastal cities with similar summer tourism and ferry/transit traffic, such as Bari, Palermo and Brindisi, adjusted to Sardinian price levels. Accommodation is benchmarked to July rates in comparable Italian port cities rather than to resort areas such as the Costa Smeralda.
